owner: Government of Cambodia / Ministry of Post and Telecommunications; NTT Data supporting
notes: Government-owned national data center in Phnom Penh (Digital Park pipeline). Groundbreaking July 2023; DCD/Khmer Times report $30m, 12-storey, Tier IV certification target (B claims). MPTC official page (A) confirms 2025-07-02 site visit by Minister Chea Vandeth, Japanese Ambassador and NTT Data (Asia-Pacific/Global DC Japan/Data Inc) reps with Tier IV standard stated; Japan grant aid up to ~$16m per DCD. Launch targeted 2025 per Knight Frank Dec 2024; ~3 MW reported in some market sources but unverified so capacity kept null.
